_comment: Fixed per-theater facts, keyed by the name DCS-gRPC's GetTheatre returns (docs/adr/0079, 0085). Read once at startup, never written by code (P5); a copy in state/theaters.json overrides it theater by theater, field by field. utcOffsetHours: local = Z + offset, standard time, no daylight saving, which is how DCS keeps time. Syria +3 is a squadron decision (decisions.md H11); every other offset is [SOURCE-DEFINED] from MOOSE's UTILS.GMTToLocalTimeDifference(). transitionAltFt: below it altitudes read QNH, at and above it flight levels. Syria 10000 is a squadron decision (H62); every other value is [SOURCE-DEFINED], kept at the 18000 every theater used before, and should be checked against that region's AIP. tmCentralMeridianDeg: the central meridian of the theater's DCS Transverse Mercator projection, for grid convergence (true = grid + convergence); mirrors tools/miztoyaml/projection.py. A theater without it has unknown convergence, so DCS grid headings there cannot be turned into true or magnetic. magneticVariation (optional, none shipped): {"fixedDeg": n} replaces the World Magnetic Model with one value for the whole map, {"offsetDeg": n} adds a squadron correction to the model. East positive. Without it, variation is WMM2025 at the position and mission date (H69).
